subject.title: fix(workspace): prevent false Missing labels on existing files and fix panel layout overlap

question: Should session workspace listings expose existence, size, and mtime for transcript-mentioned files outside the fs-safe workspace boundary?
rationale: The PR changes a security-sensitive gateway file metadata boundary; automation cannot choose whether external transcript paths should be hidden, filtered, or intentionally exposed.

options.title: Keep Metadata Inside Fs-Safe
options.body: External or fs-safe-rejected paths remain hidden or neutral, and the bug is solved by filtering or boundary-preserving semantics.

options.title: Expose External Metadata Deliberately
options.body: The gateway may return existence, size, and mtime for transcript-mentioned external paths, with explicit tests and documentation of the boundary.

recommendation.title: Keep Metadata Inside Fs-Safe
recommendation.body: External or fs-safe-rejected paths remain hidden or neutral, and the bug is solved by filtering or boundary-preserving semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent workspace browsing and file preview work makes this the strongest available owner for the fs-safe boundary decision.
